_comment: Curated target surface forms for generate_org_cooccurrence.py (GitHub issue #1). Matching is case-insensitive whole-word over lowercased article OCR; multi-word phrases are joined into pseudo-tokens before the window scan. o_id values were verified against the IWAC index (Type = Organisations) on 2026-07-03; the generator cross-checks them against index.Titre at run time and warns on drift. Edit this file to tune aliases — no code change needed. Deliberately EXCLUDED acronyms: 'cni' (in Ivorian press usually carte nationale d'identité) and 'csi' (collides with Conseil Supérieur de l'Information) — both produce more noise than signal; the spelled-out forms carry the discursive neighbourhood.
